d.ctx: The user asks to move the conversation to WhatsApp. The expert suggests staying on the current app for now.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp).

d.tr: If you want me to remove the saree, I have to do it on WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The user asked the expert to show her body/remove clothes. The expert responds that she would only do that on WhatsApp.
d.j: The expert is offering to perform a sexual act (removing clothes) on an external platform.

d.tr: WhatsApp, no need for WhatsApp, you have taken WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The user is discussing moving to WhatsApp and then asks for the number.
d.j: The user is confirming the move to an external app.

d.ctx: The expert begins dictating her phone number to the user.
d.j: The expert is providing her phone number to the user to facilitate moving off-platform.

d.tr: I will message you right now.
d.ctx: The user confirms he will message the expert on WhatsApp after receiving the number.
d.j: The user confirms the intent to contact the expert on an external app.
